title: Airway Collapse in Patients With Mounier-Kuhn Syndrome: Titration With Positive Pressure to Reduce Collapse
brief_summary: Mounier-Kuhn syndrome (MKS), or congenital tracheobronchiomegaly, is an entity characterized by dilation of the trachea and bronchi, associated with respiratory infections.The main signs and symptoms are cough, bulging and purulent expectoration, digital clubbing, dyspnoea, and wheezing.Some of these symptoms are believed to be due to excessive collapse of the intra-thoracic trachea and bronchi, resulting in airways obstruction of more than 50% . The purpose of this study is to identify and reduce tracheal collapse.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Has Mounier-Khun Syndrome
* Accept and signed informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other morbidity avoiding study procedures
